name: Grol the Destroyer
shortDescription: Grol the Destroyer, represented in the Classic research story.
body: One of Razelikh’s lieutenants, represented with an ogre-like broad frame in keeping with the quest history. Armor and facial details are interpretive. This is original interpretive art, not canonical game art or evidence for exact appearance, location, or event. See the story's visual asset ledger for the matching-build review gate.
